splitChange.observation: Not blind: the historical baseline and numerical outcome are known. Between the split body-only frames at 2500 and 3000, the compact upper-middle/right group becomes a wider branching group nearer the upper edge. The dense lower-left group clears, while the lower-middle/right bodies form a much longer vertical branching cluster. These changes affect occupied tiles and open gaps, not just colors or food outlines.
